methodology.process: One separate Node process, 3 direct uncached loader calls; no createPublishedCatalogReader wrapper and no process 3000 mutation
methodology.configuration: Read publishable config from loopback public-config endpoint into memory only; no key or environment values saved
methodology.transport: Supabase HTTPS; first call may include DNS/TLS setup, subsequent calls may reuse connections
methodology.instrumentation: A counting ReadableStream forwards decoded response bytes to the unchanged loader. No duplicate body/clone read. Total includes fetch, JSON parse and validateCatalog.
methodology.byteMeaning: decoded response bytes observed by Fetch; content-encoding retained for context; not exact compressed wire bytes
methodology.scope: Measures uncached loader cost, not full page rendering/browser metrics and not a forced restart or TTL miss inside live server 3000
